description.value: The Fernwood Inn is a community gathering place anchoring Fernwood Square in one of Victoria's oldest and most colourful neighbourhoods, serving artisan pub fare, locally-sourced organic ingredients, wild seafood, and Island microbrews. The property includes a sunny patio and a dedicated Art/Band Room that hosts live music, open mics, quiz nights, and group events. It sits directly across from the Belfry Theatre and Victoria High School, making it a lively neighbourhood landmark.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 6m; stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; rack at 31m; rack at 37m; rack at 65m; rack at 81m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone 250.412.2001, address 1302 Gladstone Ave Victoria BC V8R1S1, same URL). Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the 'FERNWOOD FOOD TO GO' section, and gluten-free options are confirmed on the /whoweare/ page ('fresh and healthy options (including gluten-free)'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Two different email addresses appear on the website: bookthefernwood@gmail.com (homepage) and thefernwoodinn@shaw.ca (menu and location pages) — minor inconsistency worth monitoring.
The /about-us/ subpage returned a 404 error; all other pages loaded correctly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating community pub in Victoria's Fernwood neighbourhood with a current website (menu updated 2026-03-02), confirmed contact details, and takeout service — useful stop for touring cyclists.
